ranking_note: Authored from the before descriptions at commit 0ad858ec054897c381bfed3e652d4236535a69a3, frozen before the rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Competitors are disk-hygiene:audit (delegated, report-only scan), disk-hygiene:check (prerequisite check), repo-hygiene:clean (one repository's caches, build output and git metadata), harness-ops:audit-install-state (~/.claude inventory) and machine-health:audit (workstation health report). Boundary: on main, clean's trigger list includes 'audit this directory' and other plain user requests to find junk or reclaim space, while audit's triggers are delegation-phrased (an orchestrator or subagent scan, a report-only snapshot), so plain user audit and find-junk requests are labeled clean positives and delegated report-only scans are clean negatives. Product-own prune commands (docker, npm) and OS-managed roots are excluded by the description and labeled negative.

queries.request: Audit my Downloads folder for junk.
My D: drive is almost full. Look through D:\scratch and tell me what's safe to delete.
There are tons of .tmp and .lock files scattered under /srv/data; help me get rid of the stale ones.
Go through ~/Downloads, find half-finished downloads and empty folders, and remove them once I approve.
I need space back on this laptop; sweep my home folder for leftover cruft.
Which files in ~/old-projects look abandoned? Show me with confidence levels before anything gets deleted.
Look for partial writes and crash debris in /var/tmp/renders and delete the ones you're sure about.
Check D:\scratch\exports for orphans and stray temp files.
Tidy up ~/Desktop, it's full of temp junk from old installs.
I'm the orchestrator: delegate a report-only scan of /srv/data to a subagent and bring the snapshot back.
Clear this repo's build output and tool caches.
Run docker system prune -a to clear out old images.
Is my Claude Code install bloated? Inventory what's in ~/.claude.
Check that the disk-hygiene plugin has the Python and node it needs.
Prune stale git branches and stashes in this repository.
Run npm cache clean --force, my npm cache is huge.
Run a workstation health check covering disk, OS updates and known exploited vulnerabilities.
Clean up C:\Windows\WinSxS to free some space on the system drive.
